family_name: Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Frame/Vertex - Square - Capped

spec.description:
Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Frame/Vertex - Square - Capped is a
modular 595mm x 595mm 3D acoustic ceiling tile designed for standard 600mm
x 600mm suspended grid systems. Available in perimeter Frame (coffer) or faceted
Vertex profiles, this capped variant includes a solid acoustic backing cap that
conceals plenum clutter. Formed from 100% polyester fibre with a minimum of 60%
recycled PET, it provides exceptional sound absorption (NRC 0.60 - 0.80) and
Group 1 fire compliance.

install:
Ensure the 600mm x 600mm ceiling
grid system is square and level

Verify all tiles in the space belong to the
same manufacturing batch

Assemble the square Frame or Vertex tile with its
acoustic backing cap securely in place

Gently push the capped tile up through
the grid aperture at a slight angle

Lower into place squarely so the tile
flanges rest securely on the grid runners

Align directional or faceted
patterns across rows to achieve the desired ceiling design

x 600mm
Choose preferred design style (Frame coffer or Vertex prism)

absorption
Select colourway from Autex Cube palette

(15mm or 24mm tee)
